items.title: Tua Tagovailoa: Will start Week 1
items.body_text: Tagovailoa will start at quarterback in Sunday's season opener against the Steelers, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Sitting out early drills Monday
items.body_text: McCaffrey (undisclosed) was not participating in drills in the early portion of the 49ers' practice Monday morning in Australia, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Misses Sunday's practice
items.body_text: Henderson (ankle) officially didn't practice Sunday, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: George Kittle: In line to practice Monday
items.body_text: Kittle (Achilles) is slated to practice Monday in Melbourne, Australia, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Puka Nacua: Expected to play in Australia
items.body_text: Rams head coach Sean McVay said Sunday that Nacua (core) is expected to play Thursday against the 49ers in Melbourne, Australia, Nate Atkins of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
